dev.keepout.inside_kept_out.text: {name} is inside {parent}, which is kept out of Images - show {parent} in Images to show {name}
dev.keepout.inside_kept_out.note: Error shown when the owner asks to show a folder in Images again (the photo library's main view) while a folder above it is still kept out of Images. {name} is the folder's name; {parent} the full path of the folder above it, such as /Photos/Private.

dev.keepout.inside_kept_out_own.text: {name} is inside {parent}, which is kept out of Images - show {parent} in Images first, then {name}
dev.keepout.inside_kept_out_own.note: Error shown when the owner asks to show a folder in Images again (the photo library's main view) while a folder above it is still kept out of Images, and the folder is kept out itself too: both need showing, the one above first. {name} is the folder's name; {parent} the full path of the folder above it, such as /Photos/Private.

dev.keepout.not_full_path.text: the folder must be a full path
dev.keepout.not_full_path.note: Error shown when keeping a folder out of Images (or showing it again) and the app sent a folder that doesn't start at the top of the library. Shown after "error updating the folder:".

dev.keepout.path_invalid.text: the folder's path is not valid
dev.keepout.path_invalid.note: Error shown when keeping a folder out of Images (or showing it again) and the folder's path has an empty, "." or ".." part. Shown after "error updating the folder:".

dev.keepout.path_too_long.text: the folder's path is too long
dev.keepout.path_too_long.note: Error shown when keeping a folder out of Images (or showing it again) and the folder's path is longer than the device can keep. Shown after "error updating the folder:".

dev.keepout.whole_library.text: the whole library can't be kept out of Images
dev.keepout.whole_library.note: Error shown when the app asked to keep the whole library (its top folder) out of Images, the photo library's main view. Shown after "error updating the folder:".
